format.description: Alias for type: code128 (default, up to 80 characters) or qr (a real QR code, up to 1,000 characters). Other values return 400.

height.description: Output height in pixels for code128 (default 100, 30-1000); a QR code is always square.

width.description: Output width in pixels (default 250, 50-2000); the barcode is scaled to fit.
